# names.button — Button has no accessible name

- **Check ID:** `names.button`
- **Default severity:** `error`; users can override it in `seaworthy.config.json`.
- **Needs:** `html`
- **Standards:** WCAG 4.1.2
- **Source module:** `packages/verify/src/checks/names.ts`
- **Prose page:** [`docs/checks/names.button.md`](../names.button.md) — embedded below verbatim; write it there, never here.

A button has no accessible name.

## Why it matters

An icon-only button is announced as just "button", so people using a screen reader cannot tell what it does.

## What it checks

A `<button>` needs text, an `<img>` with `alt`, an SVG `<title>`, or an `aria-label` / `aria-labelledby` / `title`. `<input type="button">` needs a `value`, and `<input type="image">` needs `alt`. `submit` and `reset` inputs have a default name. Hidden buttons are skipped.

## How to fix

```html
<button aria-label="Close dialog"><svg aria-hidden="true">...</svg></button>
```

## Options

None.

## Standards

- [WCAG 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/name-role-value.html)
